skill.name: seo-competitor-analysis
skill.description: Create simplified, target-first SEO organic competitor reports modeled on the approved example report style. Use for `/seo-competitor-analysis`, simplified SEO reports, organic visibility diagnosis, country traffic trend reports, Ahrefs/Semrush/Similarweb/GSC organic data analysis, page-type SEO analysis, branded versus non-branded keyword review, and backlink strategy analysis. Always generate supporting charts from normalized data before writing the report. This report is written from the perspective of someone competing against the target domain — it explains the domain's strategy, not how to improve it.
skill.userDescription: Create simplified, target-first SEO organic competitor reports modeled on the approved hix.ai report style with supporting charts and 90-day priorities.
exampleQuestions: Analyze our organic search competitors using the latest Ahrefs export and generate a 90-day SEO priority report.
Compare our branded versus non-branded keyword performance against top industry competitors using GSC and Similarweb data.
Create an organic visibility diagnosis and traffic trend report for our main target country markets.
